verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API (square-docs-17) and general API access via SDKs/MCP server that could let an agent pull payout and balance data programmatically, and idempotency/pagination guidance supports agent-driven data pulls. However, there is no direct evidence of a balance-transaction/settlement-detail endpoint linking specific charges to specific payouts, nor any documented reconciliation workflow or example showing charge-to-deposit matching. missing for 10: explicit balance-transaction/payout-detail endpoint documentation, an example or guide showing charge-to-deposit reconciliation, and confirmation the Payouts API exposes itemized transaction-level linkage rather than just payout summaries.
